text:
Maya S.: Heads up — Sandbar Health is asking for a short-term pilot pricing concession. They want a 6‑month reduced rate on Dedicated capacity (40% off list) while they run a clinical ingestion pilot. Asking for finance + ops signoff before I send a revised SOW.
Jordan (FinOps): 40% is outside standard delegated discount. Need ARR/commit, expected throughput, and whether this displaces other revenue. Can you paste the usage projection?
Olivia - AE: quick context — they’re a medtech startup; expected pilot commit = $45k/mo list (dedicated pool), projected avg tokens/day ~ 300k, spikes to 900k/day during ingestion tests. They’ll convert to reserved if pilot hits SLA. Net30 preferred.
Ben R.: do we need any custom contract terms? e.g., data residency, DPA, or extra audit rights? Legal flagged telemedicine data — might need DPA + SOC addendum.
Maya S.: Good point. They asked for our standard DPA + customer-managed KMS option. No extra IP clauses. I can add a pilot addendum: 6 months, automatic re-eval, one-time onboarding credit of $5k.
Jordan (FinOps): Run numbers: list $45k/mo x6 = $270k. At 40% off = $162k. With $5k credit effective = $157k. Need to confirm this meets minimum margin; runback from RevOps. If we approve, require Sales to document conversion trigger.
finance-bot: Reminder: discounts >30% require CFO approval per Discount Policy v2.1 and a completed Deal Desk form: https://redwood.company/deals/forms. Also record expected MRR and churn assumptions.
Olivia - AE: filling Deal Desk now, attaching projected conversion and customer engineering contact. ETA 30m.
Ben R.: Legal says DPA + KMS is fine; can sign pilot addendum. No extra indemnities.
Jordan (FinOps): Also confirm billing cadence — if they convert mid-pilot, do we prorate and switch to reserved invoices? Need to avoid double-billing. Put fallback: continue as usage-billed until conversion effective date.
Maya S.: proposed billing language (snippet):
```
Pilot Pricing Addendum:
- Term: 6 months from effective date.
- Billing: Monthly in arrears, Net30.
- Pilot Discount: 40% off standard Dedicated monthly fee.
- Onboarding Credit: $5,000 applied to first invoice.
- Conversion: If customer signs Reserved Capacity within pilot, billing will switch on signed effective date; credits will be reconciled and prorated.
```
Jordan (FinOps): Good. Two asks before I escalate to Anna: 1) confirm projected lifetime value (or minimum conversion probability), 2) confirm that Sales will accept an approval clause that requires return to full price if conversion does not happen within 9 months.
Olivia - AE: LTV estimate in Deal Desk: $1.2M ARR if they convert. Sales accepts the 9‑month conversion guardrail.
Maya S.: tagging @Anna (CFO) for final ok. Anna, this is a 40% pilot concession for a 6mo selected clinical pilot; $5k onboarding credit; DPA + KMS ok; conversion trigger documented.
Anna (CFO): copying numbers — looks like $157k effective pilot revenue, potential $1.2M ARR conversion. 40% is steep but strategic given vertical. Approve with conditions: a) require clause that price reverts if no conversion within 9 months, b) require Deal Desk entry and legal-approved addendum on file before first invoice.
Jordan (FinOps): noted. I’ll mark as approved in Deal Desk with those conditions and route to billing to implement the $5k onboarding credit and ensure proration rules.
Olivia - AE: thank you! I’ll send customer updated SOW after legal posts the addendum.
Maya S.: closing loop — I’ll attach the signed addendum to the Deal Desk record once done. :thumbsup:
Olivia - AE: :tada:
Ben R.: :eyes: good to go from legal side.
finance-bot: Deal Desk entry created: https://redwood.company/deals/2267890123 — status: pending-final-signature.
Anna (CFO): Approved (conditions acknowledged).
Maya S.: thanks all — moving to final signature.
